chron.title: Chronicle
chron.photoAlt: Wolves Brotherhood MC brothers with their bikes by factory buildings, wet-plate collodion photograph
chron.caption: The pack at the clubhouse. A wet-plate collodion plate — just like 150 years ago.
chron.lead: A brotherhood that began on a shared road and stands on its word. Here lives the club's story: how we started, the miles we've ridden and what holds us together.
diary.title: The Holy Diary
diary.sub: Every ride, every day of remembrance, every new brother. Entries the club passes on to those who come next.
ev.title: Events
cal.title: Calendar
cal.sub: Latvian name days, public holidays, days of remembrance, motorcycle days and club dates in one place.
ride.title: Ride HQ — routes
ride.sub: Club routes, rain probability along the way, wind, fuel stations and the brothers on the map in real time.
ride.f1: Enter a start and a destination. For every stretch we work out when you'll be there and the chance of rain in that very hour.
ride.f2: Gusts against the road's direction: see which stretch will push you sideways, not just the average wind in town.
ride.f3: Brothers join a ride room with a code and see each other on the map. Anyone falling behind or stopped shows up instantly.
chess.title: Chess table
chess.sub: A club game for long winter nights — against the Wolf, face to face on one screen, or online with a brother. Clock, rematch and a club rating.
chess.board: Chess board — drag or click pieces; arrow keys step through the moves
chess.noOpen: Nobody is waiting right now — throw down your own challenge!
chess.noLadder: The ladder appears after the first online game.
chess.login: The online table is for club accounts. Sign in with your Brothers online account.
chess.offlineNote: The online table runs on the club server and switches on on the published site. You can already play the Wolf or face to face.
chess.localNote: Both play on one screen. Flip the board from the Game tab.
chess.share: Send the link to a brother, or wait for someone from the club to accept.
gal.title: Gallery
mem.title: Brothers
mem.sub: Colours are never bought. They are earned with time, miles and trust.
mem.c1: Ride together, stop together. Nobody gets left at the roadside.
mem.c2: A helmet, a sound bike and a clear head. The pack rides as fast as its last rider.
mem.c3: What's promised to a brother gets done. Club business stays in the club.
merch.note: The club's full colours are never sold — the shop carries “Support” designs for friends and family. Every order is printed on demand in the EU and delivered in 3–6 working days.
don.title: Support the brotherhood
don.sub: Donations go to the clubhouse, charity rides and memorial events. Every euro shows up in the tank.
don.empty: The tank is waiting for its first litre

join.title: Want to ride with us?
join.lead: The road to colours starts with getting to know each other. Join a group ride, meet the brothers, and we'll talk from there.
join.more: Write to us too if you'd like to collaborate, hold an event with the club or support our charity rides.
join.name: Name
join.ok: Your message is ready in your email app. Send it and the brothers will reply.
